series.name: SG75CX-P2 / SG110CX-P2 / SG125CX-P2 (three-phase commercial string 75-125kW)
series.notes: PK-relevant because Energy For You (Sungrow Pakistan distributor) markets SH125CX commercially; the SG125CX-P2 is the same 125 kW three-phase commercial class. This manual documents the table as 'all PV inverters' and warns only some rows apply to the purchased model. Two structural differences from sungrow-sg-rs: (a) it HAS a rich 7-state LED table incl. Bluetooth blink (0.2s fast) and a distinctive PID-recovery pattern, whereas SG2-6RS has only 4 plain states; (b) it has NO optimizer sub-table (no 4/512/1024) even though the SG2.0-6.0RS manual does. Codes carry no leading zeros. Code 39 is explicitly named '(Earth Fault)' here but not in the RS manuals. NEVER merge with sungrow-sg (G2 Premium) - that line splits grid codes into stage I/II, this one does not.

meaning.en: Grid voltage above the set limit. The inverter reconnects to the grid once voltage is normal.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage set limit se zyada hai. Voltage theek hote hi inverter grid se dobara jud jata hai.

causes.en: Actual grid voltage higher than the set overvoltage value.
causes.ur: Asli grid voltage set overvoltage value se zyada hai.

causes.en: Overvoltage protection parameters not matched to the local grid standard.
causes.ur: Overvoltage protection parameters local grid standard se match nahi karte.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid voltage and compare with the set value in the App.
solutions.ur: Asli grid voltage naalein aur App ke set value se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the grid is genuinely high, contact the local electric power company for a solution.
solutions.ur: Agar grid sach mein high hai to local electric power company se hal manga dein.

solutions.en: Only with the local power operator's consent, adjust the overvoltage protection value via the App or LCD.
solutions.ur: Sirf local power operator ki ijazat se App ya LCD se overvoltage protection value adjust karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: Grid voltage below the set limit. The inverter waits and reconnects when the grid recovers.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage set limit se neeche hai. Grid theek hote hi inverter dobara jud jata hai.

causes.en: Actual grid voltage lower than the set undervoltage value.
causes.ur: Asli grid voltage set undervoltage value se kam hai.

causes.en: AC cable not firmly in place.
causes.ur: AC cable mazbooti se baithi nahi hai.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid voltage at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par asli grid voltage naalein.

solutions.en: Check whether the AC cable is firmly in place and re-torque all terminals.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC cable mazbooti se baithi hai aur tamam terminals dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: If the grid is genuinely low, ask the power company to correct it before raising the trip value.
solutions.ur: Agar grid sach mein kam hai to trip value barhane se pehle power company se theek karwane ko kahen.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: Grid frequency above the permitted band; the inverter waits for the grid to return to normal.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency permitted range se zyada hai; inverter grid theek hone ka intezaar karta hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the set range, often a generator-backed supply.
causes.ur: Grid frequency set range se bahar, aksar generator wali supply.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the set range, often a generator-backed supply.
causes.ur: Grid frequency set range se bahar, aksar generator wali supply.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid frequency and confirm it is beyond the set range.
solutions.ur: Asli grid frequency naalein aur confirm karein ke set range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: If out of range, ask the local electric power company or genset owner to correct it.
solutions.ur: Agar range se bahar hai to local electric power company ya genset owner se theek karwane ko kahen.

solutions.en: Check whether the protection parameters are appropriately set via the App or LCD.
solutions.ur: Check karein App ya LCD se protection parameters theek set hain ya nahi.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: Grid frequency below the permitted band; the inverter waits for the grid to return to normal.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency permitted range se neeche hai; inverter grid theek hone ka intezaar karta hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the set range, e.g. an overloaded generator or a large motor start.
causes.ur: Grid frequency set range se bahar, jaise overloaded generator ya koi bara motor start.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the set range, e.g. an overloaded generator or a large motor start.
causes.ur: Grid frequency set range se bahar, jaise overloaded generator ya koi bara motor start.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid frequency and note the reading and the trip time.
solutions.ur: Asli grid frequency naalein aur reading aur trip ka waqt note karein.

solutions.en: If beyond the set range, ask the local electric power company to correct it.
solutions.ur: Agar set range se bahar hai to local electric power company se theek karwane ko kahen.

solutions.en: Check whether the protection parameters are appropriately set via the App or LCD.
solutions.ur: Check karein App ya LCD se protection parameters theek set hain ya nahi.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: The grid supply was lost or not detected, so the inverter disconnected to avoid islanding.
meaning.ur: Grid supply chala gaya ya detect nahi hua, is liye inverter islanding se bachne ke liye disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Actual grid outage or the AC circuit breaker has tripped.
causes.ur: Asli grid outage ya AC circuit breaker trip ho gaya.

causes.en: AC cable loose, or live and N connected to the wrong terminals.
causes.ur: AC cable loose, ya live aur N galat terminals se jude hue hain.

causes.en: AC circuit breaker not connected.
causes.ur: AC circuit breaker jari nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the grid supplies power reliably with a meter at the distribution board.
solutions.ur: Distribution board par meter se check karein ke grid mehfooz power de raha hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the AC cable is firmly in place and re-torque every AC terminal.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC cable mazbooti se baithi hai aur har AC terminal dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Verify the AC cable is on the correct terminals - live and N must not be swapped.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein AC cable sahi terminals par hain - live aur N swap na hon.

solutions.en: Check the AC circuit breaker is connected.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC circuit breaker jari (connected) hai.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: Insulation leakage current was too high, often from damp conditions; the inverter reconnects once conditions improve.
meaning.ur: Insulation leakage current bohat zyada tha, aksar geele mahol ki wajah se; conditions theek hote hi inverter dobara jud jata hai.

causes.en: Poor sunlight or a damp environment around the modules and cables.
causes.ur: Modules aur cables ke aas paas dhoop kam ya geela mahol.

causes.en: AC or DC cable insulation degraded.
causes.ur: AC ya DC cable ki insulation kharab ho gayi.

solutions.en: Let the environment dry out - the inverter usually reconnects by itself.
solutions.ur: Mahol sukha hone dein - inverter aam tor par khud dobara jud jata hai.

solutions.en: If the environment is normal, check AC and DC cable insulation with an insulation tester.
solutions.ur: Agar mahol normal hai to insulation tester se AC aur DC cable ki insulation check karein.

solutions.en: Replace any cable with failed insulation and re-seal the damp connectors.
solutions.ur: Insulation fail hui cable badal dein aur geele connectors dobara seal karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: A general grid parameter went outside the set range - grid quality not covered by a specific voltage or frequency code.
meaning.ur: Grid ka koi aam parameter set range se bahar chala gaya - wo grid quality masla jo kisi khaas voltage ya frequency code se cover nahi hota.

causes.en: Grid parameter such as distortion or inter-harmonics exceeds the set range.
causes.ur: Grid parameter jaise distortion ya harmonics set range se zyada hai.

causes.en: Unstable local supply from a weak or overloaded distribution transformer.
causes.ur: Kamzor ya overloaded distribution transformer se unstable local supply.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid; if parameters exceed the set range, ask the power company for a solution.
solutions.ur: Asli grid naalein; parameters set range se zyada hon to power company se hal manga dein.

solutions.en: Record the grid condition and trip time so the utility can investigate.
solutions.ur: Trip ka grid condition aur waqt note karein taake utility investigate kar sake.

solutions.en: Do not widen the protection window yourself as a first step.
solutions.ur: Pehla step apne aap protection window bara na karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.ur: Grid phase voltages ka farq zyada (17)

meaning.en: The three phase grid voltages differ by more than allowed. Expected on this 75-125 kW three-phase commercial unit.
meaning.ur: Teen phase grid voltages ka farq mojood se zyada hai. Is 75-125 kW teen phase commercial unit par ye aam baat hai.

causes.en: Large single-phase loads unevenly distributed across the three phases.
causes.ur: Teen phases par bare single-phase loads uneven taqseem hue hain.

causes.en: Unbalanced distribution transformer or a weak neutral at this commercial connection.
causes.ur: Is commercial connection par unbalanced distribution transformer ya kamzor neutral.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid voltage on all three phases and compare the readings.
solutions.ur: Teen phases ka asli grid voltage naalein aur readings compare karein.

solutions.en: If the phase voltages differ greatly, contact the electric power company for a solution.
solutions.ur: Agar phase voltages mein bohat farq ho to electric power company se hal manga dein.

solutions.en: If within the power company's permissible range, adjust the imbalance parameter via the App or LCD.
solutions.ur: Agar power company ki permissible range mein hai to App ya LCD se imbalance parameter adjust karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: PV strings are wired in reverse polarity. Codes 28-29 map to PV1-PV2; 448-479 to string 1-32.
meaning.ur: PV strings ulta polarity se jade hain. Codes 28-29 PV1-PV2 ke hain; 448-479 string 1-32 ke hain.

causes.en: MC4 connector crimped backwards during installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke dauraan MC4 connector ulta crimp ho gaya.

causes.en: String cables swapped at the DC input terminals of a 9-12 MPP tracker unit.
causes.ur: 9-12 MPP tracker unit ke DC input terminals par string cables aapas mein badal diye gaye.

solutions.en: Check whether the corresponding string is of reverse polarity with a meter before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhune se pehle meter se check karein ke us string ki polarity reverse hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If reverse, disconnect the DC switch and adjust the polarity once string current drops below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: Agar reverse hai to DC switch disconnect karke string current 0.5 A se neeche hone par polarity adjust karein.

solutions.en: Then re-measure the open-circuit voltage to confirm correct polarity before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Phir sahi polarity ki tasdeeq ke liye open-circuit voltage dobara naalein, phir dobara power dein.

notes.en: The manual prints 'PV Reserve Con-nection Fault' - a typo for 'PV Reverse'. The SH manual prints it correctly. Recorded verbatim in the title so the typo is visible in the KB.
notes.ur: Manual 'PV Reserve Con-nection Fault' likhta hai - ye 'PV Reverse' ka typo hai. SH manual ise theek likhta hai. Typo KB mein nazar aaye is liye title mein verbatim rakha gaya hai.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: Reverse polarity on a monitored string. Codes 532-547 map to string 1-16; 564-579 to string 17-32.
meaning.ur: Monitored string par reverse polarity. Codes 532-547 string 1-16 ke hain; 564-579 string 17-32 ke hain.

causes.en: String connected in reverse polarity, or a monitoring channel reporting the wrong direction.
causes.ur: String reverse polarity se jodi, ya monitoring channel galat direction report kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the corresponding string is of reverse polarity and adjust the polarity once current is below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: Check karein us string ki polarity reverse hai ya nahi aur current 0.5 A se neeche hone par polarity adjust karein.

solutions.en: If the wiring is correct, check the monitoring device on that specific string.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring sahi hai to us khaas string ka monitoring device check karein.

solutions.en: If the alarm still exists, contact Sungrow Power Customer Service.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Power Customer Service se rabta karein.

notes.en: Named 'Alarm' in the manual, so isFault is false.
notes.ur: Manual mein 'Alarm' likha hai, is liye isFault false hai.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.ur: PV string ka voltage/current ghalat, alarm (548-563, 580-595)

meaning.en: String voltage or current is abnormal - a mismatch, sheltering or a fuse problem. Codes 548-563 map to string 1-16; 580-595 to string 17-32.
meaning.ur: String ka voltage ya current abnormal hai - mismatch, sheltering ya fuse ki masla. Codes 548-563 string 1-16 ke hain; 580-595 string 17-32 ke hain.

causes.en: Module sheltered by dust, bird droppings or other obstruction - common on large commercial rooftop arrays.
causes.ur: Module par dhool, parinde ki keed ya doosri cheez chhaayi hui hai - bade commercial rooftop arrays par aam baat hai.

causes.en: Battery board wiring loose in the combiner.
causes.ur: Combiner mein battery board ki wiring loose hai.

causes.en: DC fuse in that string damaged or blown.
causes.ur: Us string ka DC fuse kharab ya uda hua hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the corresponding module is sheltered; remove the shelter and ensure module cleanliness.
solutions.ur: Check karein module dhakka hua hai ya nahi; dhakka hata dein aur module saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the battery board wiring is loose and make it reliably connected.
solutions.ur: Check karein battery board ki wiring loose hai ya nahi aur mazbooti se jodein.

solutions.en: Check if the DC fuse is damaged; replace it with the correct rating.
solutions.ur: Check karein DC fuse kharab hai ya nahi; sahi rating ka naya lagayein.

solutions.en: If the alarm still exists, contact Sungrow Power Customer Service.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Power Customer Service se rabta karein.

notes.en: This unit has NO battery, yet the row still says 'battery board wiring' - carried over verbatim from the shared hybrid-platform table. On CX-P2 this means the COMBINER board wiring, not a battery board.
notes.ur: Is unit mein koi battery nahi hai, magar row mein phir bhi 'battery board wiring' likha hai - ye shared hybrid-platform table se verbatim aaya hai. CX-P2 par is ka matlab COMBINER board ki wiring hai, battery board ki nahi.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: Inverter or module temperature above the limit. The inverter resumes when the temperature returns to normal.
meaning.ur: Inverter ya module ka temperature limit se zyada hai. Temperature theek hote hi wapas chal pada hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature at the site too high, typical of an unventilated plant room.
causes.ur: Site ka ambient temperature bohat zyada hai, ventilation na wali plant room mein aam baat hai.

causes.en: Poor ventilation or direct sunlight on the enclosure.
causes.ur: Kam ventilation ya enclosure par seedhi dhoop.

causes.en: Cooling fan not running properly on this fan-cooled 125 kW unit.
causes.ur: Is fan-cooled 125 kW unit par cooling fan theek se nahi chal raha.

solutions.en: Check whether the ambient temperature of the inverter is too high and wait for it to drop.
solutions.ur: Check karein inverter ka ambient temperature bohat zyada hai ya nahi aur girne dein.

solutions.en: Check whether the inverter is in a well-ventilated place and confirm clearance around it.
solutions.ur: Check karein inverter ventilation wali jagah hai aur aas paas ki required jagah hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If exposed to direct sunlight, shield it; then check the fan is running properly and replace it if not.
solutions.ur: Agar seedhi dhoop mein hai to shield karein; phir check karein fan theek chal raha hai aur na chal raha ho to badal dein.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Power Customer Service if the fault is due to other causes and persists.
solutions.ur: Agar fault doosri wajuh se hai aur phir bhi rahta hai to Sungrow Power Customer Service se rabta karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: Ambient temperature below the operating range. The inverter must be stopped and restarted when temperature recovers.
meaning.ur: Ambient temperature operating range se neeche hai. Temperature theek hote hi inverter band karke dobara start karna hoga.

causes.en: Winter or night-time ambient temperature below the inverter's minimum operating temperature.
causes.ur: Sarmay ya raat ka ambient temperature inverter ke minimum operating temperature se neeche.

causes.en: Winter or night-time ambient temperature below the inverter's minimum operating temperature.
causes.ur: Sarmay ya raat ka ambient temperature inverter ke minimum operating temperature se neeche gir gaya.

solutions.en: Stop and disconnect the inverter as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter band karke disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter when the ambient temperature rises within the operation temperature range.
solutions.ur: Jab ambient temperature operation temperature range mein aa jaye to inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Note the seasonal limit for the site owner - Pakistani winter nights commonly trip this code.
solutions.ur: Site owner ko seasonal limit bata dein - Pakistan ki sarmay ki raatein aam tor par ye code trigger karti hain.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.en: Low System Insulation Resistance / Earth Fault (39)
title.ur: System Insulation Resistance kam / Earth Fault (39)

meaning.en: Insulation resistance to earth is too low, i.e. an earth fault exists. The inverter stops to avoid shock.
meaning.ur: Earth ke khilaf insulation resistance bohat kam hai, yaani earth fault maujood hai. Shock se bachne ke liye inverter band ho jata hai.

causes.en: ISO resistance protection value set excessively high, outside local regulations.
causes.ur: ISO resistance protection value bohat high rakha gaya, local regulations se bahar.

causes.en: String or DC cable short-circuited to ground, or damaged insulation layer.
causes.ur: String ya DC cable ground se short ho gaya, ya insulation layer kharab.

causes.en: Rain and moisture getting into connectors on a large outdoor array.
causes.ur: Bade outdoor array par baarish ki moisture connectors mein aa rahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the ISO resistance protection value is excessively high in the App or LCD and ensure it complies with local regulations.
solutions.ur: App ya LCD mein check karein ISO resistance protection value bohat high to nahi, aur local regulations ke mutabiq hone ko confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the resistance to ground of the string and DC cable, and correct any short circuit or damaged insulation layer.
solutions.ur: String aur DC cable ki ground ke khilaf resistance check karein, aur koi short circuit ya kharab insulation layer theek karein.

solutions.en: If the cable is normal and the fault only occurs on rainy days, re-check when the weather clears.
solutions.ur: Agar cable normal hai aur fault sirf baarish ke din aata hai to mausam kharab hone par dobara check karein.

solutions.en: This manual also lists checking battery cables - on CX-P2 there is no battery, so substitute the combiner/earthing cable check.
solutions.ur: Is manual mein battery cables check karne ko bhi likha hai - CX-P2 par koi battery nahi, is liye us ki jagah combiner/earthing cable check karein.

notes.en: This manual names code 39 explicitly as '(Earth Fault)'. The single-phase RS and SH manuals name the same 39 as 'Low System Insulation Resistance' with no earth-fault wording. Same code, slightly different naming - do not treat as a different fault.
notes.ur: Ye manual code 39 ko saaf '(Earth Fault)' kehta hai. Single-phase RS aur SH manuals isi 39 ko 'Low System Insulation Resistance' kehte hain, earth-fault lafz ke baghair. Same code, thora mukhtalif naam - alag fault na samajhein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: The AC ground cable is not correctly connected, or its insulation to the live wire is not normal.
meaning.ur: AC ground cable sahi se judi nahi hai, ya live wire ke khilaf us ki insulation normal nahi hai.

causes.en: AC cable not correctly connected to the PE terminal.
causes.ur: AC cable PE terminal par sahi se judi nahi hai.

causes.en: Insulation between the ground cable and the live wire is not normal.
causes.ur: Ground cable aur live wire ke darmiyan insulation normal nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the AC cable is correctly connected to the PE terminal.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC cable PE terminal par sahi se judi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check the insulation between the ground cable and the live wire with an insulation tester.
solutions.ur: Insulation tester se ground cable aur live wire ke darmiyan insulation check karein.

solutions.en: Re-torque the PE terminal or replace the ground cable, then contact service if it persists.
solutions.ur: PE terminal dobara tighten karein ya ground cable badal dein, phir phir bhi rahe to service se rabta karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: The AFCI detected an arc in the PV DC wiring. Urgent fire risk on a 125 kW multi-string array.
meaning.ur: AFCI ne PV DC wiring mein arc detect kiya. 125 kW multi-string array par ye fori fire risk hai.

causes.en: Loose terminal or fuse, or a weak contact on one of the many PV string connections.
causes.ur: Bohat se PV string connections mein kisi ek par loose terminal ya fuse, ya kamzor contact.

causes.en: DC cable damaged or a burnt component arcing under load.
causes.ur: DC cable kharab ya load par jala hua component chingaar maar raha hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC power supply first, then check every DC cable, connection terminal and fuse for damage or weakness.
solutions.ur: Pehle DC power supply disconnect karein, phir har DC cable, connection terminal aur fuse ko nuksan ya kamzori ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged cable, fasten the terminal or fuse, and replace the burnt component.
solutions.ur: Kharab cable badal dein, terminal ya fuse tighten karein, aur jala hua component badal dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect the DC power supply, then clear the arc fault via the App or LCD.
solutions.ur: DC power supply dobara jodein, phir App ya LCD se arc fault clear karein.

solutions.en: On an array of this size use a thermal camera on the combiner boxes to find the hot connection fast.
solutions.ur: Is size ke array par combiner boxes par thermal camera se garam connection jaldi dhoondein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.en: Reverse Connection Alarm of the Meter/CT (84)

meaning.en: The export meter or CT is connected backwards, so export readings will be wrong.
meaning.ur: Export meter ya CT ulta juda hai, is liye export readings ghalat honge.

causes.en: Meter connected to the wrong point in the circuit.
causes.ur: Meter circuit mein galat jagah laga hai.

causes.en: Meter input and output wiring reversed.
causes.ur: Meter ka input aur output wiring aapas mein ulat diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Existing inverter enabled without the correct rated power setting on a multi-inverter site.
causes.ur: Multi-inverter site par existing inverter enable kiya gaya magar rated power setting sahi nahi ki gayi.

solutions.en: Check if the meter is wrongly connected and move it to the correct export-side point.
solutions.ur: Check karein meter galat jagah lagi hai ya nahi aur use sahi export-side jagah le jayein.

solutions.en: Check if the input and output wiring of the meter is reversed and swap the two conductors.
solutions.ur: Check karein meter ka input aur output wiring ulat diya gaya hai ya nahi aur do conductors aapas mein badal dein.

solutions.en: If the existing system is enabled, check that the rated power setting of the existing inverter is correct.
solutions.ur: Agar existing system enabled hai to check karein ke existing inverter ki rated power setting sahi hai.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.ur: Meter se baat nahi ban rahi, alarm (514)

meaning.en: The inverter cannot read the export meter. Generation continues; only monitoring is affected.
meaning.ur: Inverter export meter nahi parh sakta. Generation chalti rehti hai; sirf monitoring ka nuksan hai.

causes.en: Communication cable or terminals abnormal, loose or not correctly shielded.
causes.ur: Communication cable ya terminals kharab, loose ya sahi tareeqe se shield nahi hui.

causes.en: RS485 A/B polarity swapped on a long commercial-site cable run.
causes.ur: Lambi commercial-site cable run par RS485 ki A/B polarity swap ho gayi.

solutions.en: Check the communication cable and terminals and correct them for a reliable connection.
solutions.ur: Communication cable aur terminals check karke theek karein taake reliable connection ho.

solutions.en: Reconnect the communication cable of the meter.
solutions.ur: Meter ka communication cable dobara jodein.

solutions.en: Swap RS485 A/B if it still fails - verify polarity at both ends of a long run.
solutions.ur: Agar phir bhi na ho to RS485 A/B aapas mein badal dein - lambi run ke dono siron par polarity verify karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.ur: Grid se takrao - dono taraf power (323)

meaning.en: The inverter's output port is wired to the actual grid, so two sources are back-feeding each other. Illegal and dangerous.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output port asal grid se juda hai, is liye do sources aapas mein power wapas bhej rahe hain. Yeh qanooni aur khatarnaak hai.

causes.en: Output port wired to the utility grid instead of to the intended separate load panel.
causes.ur: Output port utility grid se juda hai bajaye ke sochay huay alag load panel se.

causes.en: Installer error during the grid-tie connection.
causes.ur: Grid-tie connection ke dauraan installer ki ghalti.

solutions.en: Check whether the output port is connected to the actual grid.
solutions.ur: Check karein output port asal grid se juda hua hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it is, disconnect it from the grid immediately - this is the first action.
solutions.ur: Agar haan hai to turant grid se disconnect kar dein - ye sab se pehla action hai.

solutions.en: Rewire to the intended separate panel and verify isolation with a meter before restarting.
solutions.ur: Sochay huay alag panel mein dobara jodein aur restart se pehle meter se isolation verify karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: Communication between paralleled inverters is unreliable, so the parallel group is degraded.
meaning.ur: Parallel inverters ke darmiyan communication reliable nahi hai, is liye parallel group kamzor ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Communication cable or terminals abnormal, loose or not correctly terminated.
causes.ur: Communication cable ya terminals kharab, loose ya sahi tareeqe se terminate nahi hue.

solutions.en: Check the communication cable and terminals and correct them for a reliable connection.
solutions.ur: Communication cable aur terminals check karke theek karein taake reliable connection ho.

solutions.en: Reconnect the communication cable between the parallel units.
solutions.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan communication cable dobara jodein.

solutions.en: Confirm the master/slave roles are set correctly for the parallel group.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein parallel group ke liye master/slave roles sahi set hain.

notes.en: Parallel operation is a real supported function on commercial 75-125 kW units, so this code is expected here.
notes.ur: Commercial 75-125 kW units par parallel operation asal supported function hai, is liye ye code yahan aana mumkin hai.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: A string is reverse connected into a specific MPPT input. Codes 264-279 map to string 1-20.
meaning.ur: Koi string kisi khaas MPPT input mein ulta polarity se jodi gayi hai. Codes 264-279 string 1-20 ke hain.

causes.en: String connected to the wrong MPPT input on a tracker with 9-12 MPPTs.
causes.ur: 9-12 MPPT wale tracker par string galat MPPT input se jodi gayi.

causes.en: The connector at that MPPT is reversed.
causes.ur: Us MPPT ka connector ulta hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the corresponding string is of reverse polarity and correct it once current drops below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: Check karein us string ki polarity reverse hai ya nahi aur current 0.5 A se neeche girne par theek karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the string is on the MPPT input it is rated for - a 125 kW unit has many inputs to confuse.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein string us MPPT input par hai jis ke liye rated hai - 125 kW unit mein inputs bohat hain jahan ghalti ho sakti hai.

solutions.en: Re-measure the open-circuit voltage at the string before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Dobara power dene se pehle string ka open-circuit voltage dobara naalein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: A boost capacitor is running at overvoltage. The inverter can keep running while this is investigated.
meaning.ur: Koi boost capacitor overvoltage par chal raha hai. Jitni der jaanch chal rahi hai, inverter chalta rahe sakta hai.

causes.en: Boost capacitor ageing or a DC link capacitor losing capacitance.
causes.ur: Boost capacitor ki umar ya DC link capacitor ka capacitance kam hona.

causes.en: Foreign material or an environmental issue on the boost stage.
causes.ur: Boost stage par bahri cheez ya mahol ki masla.

solutions.en: The inverter can continue running - note the code and monitor the trend rather than powering down immediately.
solutions.ur: Inverter chalta rahe sakta hai - turant band karne ke bajaye code note karein aur trend dekhein.

solutions.en: Check the related wiring and terminals, and for foreign material or other environmental abnormalities.
solutions.ur: Related wiring aur terminals check karein, aur bahri cheez ya doosri environmental abnormality dekhein.

solutions.en: Take the corresponding corrective measures when necessary, then re-check.
solutions.ur: Jab zarurat ho to mutabiq corrective measures lein, phir dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, contact Sungrow Power Customer Service.
solutions.ur: Agar fault phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Power Customer Service se rabta karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: The boost capacitor overvoltage has escalated to a fault. A full 15-minute AC/DC restart cycle is required.
meaning.ur: Boost capacitor overvoltage fault tak pohanch gaya hai. Poora 15 minute ka AC/DC restart cycle zaruri hai.

causes.en: Boost capacitor failed or lost capacitance after the alarm stage was not addressed.
causes.ur: Alert ignore karne ke baad boost capacitor fail ho gaya ya us ka capacitance kam ho gaya.

causes.en: A second cause is not published - the manual gives only the restart procedure for this row.
causes.ur: Doosri wajah publish nahi - manual is row ke liye sirf restart procedure deta hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the AC and DC switches. (This unit has no battery, so no battery-side switch step applies.)
solutions.ur: AC aur DC switches disconnect karein. (Is unit mein koi battery nahi, is liye battery-side switch ka step applicable nahi.)

solutions.en: Close the AC and DC switches in turn 15 minutes later and restart the system.
solutions.ur: 15 minute baad AC aur DC switches ek ek karke band karein aur system restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the code does not return; a repeat means the capacitor has actually failed.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein code wapas nahi aata; dobara aane ka matlab hai capacitor asal mein fail ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, contact Sungrow Power Customer Service.
solutions.ur: Agar fault phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Power Customer Service se rabta karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.ur: String ka current peeche beh raha (1548-1579)

meaning.en: Current is flowing backwards from one string into another, usually because that string has fewer modules or is shaded.
meaning.ur: Ek string se doosri mein current peeche beh raha hai, aam tor par is liye ke us string mein modules kam hain ya woh shaded hai.

causes.en: Fewer PV modules in that string than in the other paralleled strings.
causes.ur: Us string mein doosri parallel strings se kam PV modules hain.

causes.en: PV module partially shaded - very common on large commercial rooftop arrays.
causes.ur: PV module adhoora shaded hai - bade commercial rooftop arrays par bohat aam baat hai.

causes.en: PV module mounted in the wrong orientation.
causes.ur: PV module galat direction mein laga hai.

solutions.en: Check the number of PV modules in the flagged string against the other strings, and adjust the configuration with DC off once current is below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: Flag hui string ke modules ki tadaad doosri strings se compare karein, aur current 0.5 A se neeche hone par DC off karke configuration adjust karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the PV module is shaded; on commercial arrays check for parapet, AC duct or other structure shadows.
solutions.ur: Check karein PV module shaded to nahi; commercial arrays par parapet, AC duct ya doosri structure ki saaya dekhein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch and check the open-circuit voltage once current is below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: DC switch disconnect karke current 0.5 A se neeche hone par open-circuit voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check the wiring, the PV module configuration and the module orientation.
solutions.ur: Wiring, PV module configuration aur module ki direction check karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: A string has a ground fault. Never unplug PV terminals while DC current is above 0.5 A.
meaning.ur: Kisi string par ground fault hai. DC current 0.5 A se upar hone par PV terminals kabhi na nikaalein.

causes.en: String cable insulation damaged and touching the frame or a metal structure.
causes.ur: String cable ki insulation kharab ho kar frame ya metal structure ko chhu rahi hai.

causes.en: Module or junction box water ingress creating a path to earth.
causes.ur: Module ya junction box mein paas ja kar earth tak raasta ban gaya.

solutions.en: When the fault occurs, it is forbidden to directly disconnect the DC switch and unplug PV terminals when the direct current is greater than 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: Fault hone par, jab direct current 0.5 A se zyada ho to DC switch seedha disconnect karna aur PV terminals nikalna mana hai.

solutions.en: Wait until the direct current of the inverter falls below 0.5 A, then disconnect the DC switch and unplug the faulty strings.
solutions.ur: Inverter ka direct current 0.5 A se neeche girne ka intezaar karein, phir DC switch disconnect karke kharab strings nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Do not reinsert the faulty strings before the grounding fault is cleared.
solutions.ur: Grounding fault hal hone se pehle kharab strings dobara mat lagayein.

solutions.en: Contact Sungrow Customer Service if the fault is not caused by the foregoing reasons and still exists.
solutions.ur: Agar upar wali wajuhon se nahi hua aur phir bhi mojood hai to Sungrow Customer Service se rabta karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: A hardware-level fault inside the inverter. The manual explicitly forbids powering the inverter back up.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar hardware level ka fault hai. Manual saaf mana karta hai ke inverter dobara power on na kiya jaye.

causes.en: Internal component failure detected at hardware level (board, sensor or power stage).
causes.ur: Hardware level par internal component failure detect hua (board, sensor ya power stage).

causes.en: A second cause is not published - the manual gives a prohibition plus a service instruction instead of a diagnosis.
causes.ur: Doosri wajah bhi publish nahi - manual diagnosis ke bajaye prohibition aur service instruction deta hai.

solutions.en: It is prohibited to disconnect the DC switch when the DC current is greater than 0.5 A when the fault occurs.
solutions.ur: Fault hone ke waqt DC current 0.5 A se zyada ho to DC switch disconnect karna mana hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch only when the inverter DC side current drops below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: DC switch sirf tab disconnect karein jab inverter ke DC side ka current 0.5 A se neeche gir jaye.

solutions.en: It is prohibited to power up the inverter again - contact Sungrow Customer Service.
solutions.ur: Inverter dobara power on karna mana hai - Sungrow Customer Service se rabta karein.

notes.en: The strictest code in this table: no restart step at all. On a 125 kW unit the DC side can carry hundreds of amps, so the 0.5 A rule must be verified with a clamp meter, not assumed.
notes.ur: Is table ka sab se sakht code: bilkul koi restart step nahi. 125 kW unit par DC side se s hundreds of amps ja sakte hain, is liye 0.5 A ka rule clamp meter se verify karein, maan na lein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: A catch-all row covering roughly 150 unnamed internal hardware and control fault codes.
meaning.ur: Ye ek catch-all row hai jo lagbhag 150 unnamed internal hardware aur control fault codes ko cover karta hai.

causes.en: Internal hardware or control fault in the inverter, device by device within the listed range.
causes.ur: Listed range mein kisi bhi device ka internal hardware ya control fault.

causes.en: The manual gives no per-code causes, so any specific code in the range can only be diagnosed from the symptom.
causes.ur: Manual per-code wajah nahi deta, is liye range ka koi bhi khaas code sirf symptom se diagnose ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the inverter to return to normal on its own first.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter ko khud theek hone ka intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the AC and DC switches (no battery on this model).
solutions.ur: AC aur DC switches disconnect karein (is model mein battery nahi).

solutions.en: Close the AC and DC switches in turn 15 minutes later and restart the system.
solutions.ur: 15 minute baad AC aur DC switches ek ek karke band karein aur system restart karein.

solutions.en: If the fault still exists, contact Sungrow Customer Service.
solutions.ur: Agar fault phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Customer Service se rabta karein.

notes.en: One entry with the range in aliases, matching how the manual documents it. This manual's list ends at 1096-1122, matching SH8.0-10RS, NOT the single-phase RS manual's 1096-1118. See CONFLICTS.
notes.ur: Ek entry, aliases mein range, manual ke mutabiq. Is manual ki list 1096-1122 par khatam hoti hai, SH8.0-10RS se match karti hai, single-phase RS ki 1096-1118 se nahi. CONFLICTS dekhein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

meaning.en: A catch-all warning-class row. The inverter keeps running while these minor internal conditions are corrected.
meaning.ur: Ye ek catch-all warning-class row hai. In in chhoti internal ghalatiyon ke dauraan inverter chalta rahta hai.

causes.en: Minor internal wiring or terminal abnormality, foreign material, or an environmental issue.
causes.ur: Internal wiring ya terminal ki chhoti ghalati, bahri cheez, ya mahol ki masla.

solutions.en: The inverter can continue running - no urgent shutdown needed.
solutions.ur: Inverter chalta rahe sakta hai - foran band karne ki zarurat nahi.

solutions.en: Check the related wiring and terminals, and for foreign material or other environmental abnormalities.
solutions.ur: Related wiring aur terminals check karein, aur bahri cheez ya doosri environmental abnormality dekhein.

solutions.en: Take the corresponding corrective measures when necessary.
solutions.ur: Jab zarurat ho to mutabiq corrective measures lein.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, contact Sungrow Power Customer Service.
solutions.ur: Agar fault phir bhi rahe to Sungrow Power Customer Service se rabta karein.

notes.en: One entry with the range in aliases, as documented. The list is identical to the single-phase RS and SH System Alarm rows.
notes.ur: Ek entry, aliases mein range, jaise document kiya gaya hai. Ye list single-phase RS aur SH ke System Alarm rows ke bilkul same hai.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.en: LED blue on - normal grid operation
title.ur: LED blue chala - grid par theek chal raha hai

meaning.en: The blue LED is on: the device is connected to the grid and operating normally.
meaning.ur: Blue LED on hai: device grid se juda hai aur normally kaam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Normal grid-tied generation within all limits.
causes.ur: Sab limits ke andar normal grid par generation.

solutions.en: No action needed - this is the healthy state.
solutions.ur: Koi action ki zarurat nahi - ye theek hal ka state hai.

solutions.en: Confirm active power in iSolarCloud as a sanity check.
solutions.ur: Sanity check ke taur par iSolarCloud mein active power confirm karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.en: LED blue fast blink 0.2s - Bluetooth connected
title.ur: LED blue tez blink 0.2s - Bluetooth connected

meaning.en: The blue LED blinks fast at 0.2s period: the Bluetooth connection is established and data communication is happening.
meaning.ur: Blue LED 0.2s period par tez blink karta hai: Bluetooth connection establish ho gaya hai aur data communication chal raha hai.

causes.en: Technician or app connected over Bluetooth for commissioning or monitoring.
causes.ur: Commissioning ya monitoring ke liye technician ya app Bluetooth se juda hai.

solutions.en: No action needed - this is a normal communication state, not a fault.
solutions.ur: Koi action ki zarurat nahi - ye normal communication state hai, fault nahi.

solutions.en: If nobody is connected, disconnect the phone and confirm the LED settles to blue on.
solutions.ur: Agar koi juda nahi hai to phone disconnect karein aur confirm karein LED blue on par aa jata hai.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.en: LED blue slow blink 2s - standby or startup
title.ur: LED blue dheema blink 2s - standby ya startup

meaning.en: The blue LED blinks slowly at 2s period: the device is in standby or startup and is NOT feeding power into the grid. No system fault is present.
meaning.ur: Blue LED 2s period par dheere blink karta hai: device standby ya startup mein hai aur grid mein power nahi bhej raha. Koi system fault nahi hai.

causes.en: Grid parameters not yet satisfied, so the inverter is waiting to connect.
causes.ur: Grid parameters abhi satisfy nahi hue, is liye inverter connect hone ka intezaar kar raha hai.

causes.en: Startup self-test in progress after power-on.
causes.ur: Power-on ke baad startup self-test chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Wait 1-3 minutes for the startup self-test to complete before assuming a fault.
solutions.ur: Fault samajhne se pehle startup self-test poora hone ka 1-3 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check grid voltage, frequency and that the AC breaker is closed.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage, frequency aur AC breaker bandh (closed) hone ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: If standby persists beyond 10 minutes, check the App or LCD for an active code.
solutions.ur: Agar standby 10 minute se zyada rahe to App ya LCD mein koi active code check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Blue LED slow blink, period 2s, no system fault

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.en: LED blue slow blink once then fast 3x - PID recovery
title.ur: LED blue ek baar dheema phir tez 3 baar - PID recovery

meaning.en: A distinctive diagnostic pattern: the blue LED slow-blinks once then fast-blinks three times, indicating the inverter is running PID (potential induced degradation) recovery.
meaning.ur: Ek khaas diagnostic pattern: blue LED ek baar dheere blink karta hai phir tez teen baar - is ka matlab inverter PID (potential induced degradation) recovery chala raha hai.

causes.en: Automatic anti-PID recovery routine energising the PV array overnight to remove moisture-induced leakage.
causes.ur: Automatic anti-PID recovery routine raat ko PV array ko energise karke moisture-induced leakage hatata hai.

solutions.en: This is a normal routine, not a fault - do not interrupt it by switching off the DC.
solutions.ur: Ye normal routine hai, fault nahi - DC off karke ise interrupt na karein.

solutions.en: Allow it to finish; PV generation is stopped while PID recovery runs.
solutions.ur: Ise poora hone dein; PID recovery chalne ke dauraan PV generation band rehta hai.

solutions.en: If this pattern appears during daytime production, check the PID recovery schedule in the App.
solutions.ur: Agar ye pattern din mein production ke dauraan aaye to App mein PID recovery ka schedule check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Blue LED slow blink once, then fast blink three times

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.en: LED red on - fault, cannot connect to grid
title.ur: LED red on - fault, grid se nahi jud sakta

meaning.en: The red LED is on: a fault has occurred and the device cannot connect to the grid.
meaning.ur: Red LED on hai: fault aa gaya hai aur device grid se nahi jud sakta.

causes.en: Any active fault code preventing grid connection - read the code from the App or LCD.
causes.ur: Grid connection rokne wala koi bhi active fault code - code App ya LCD se parh lein.

causes.en: A grounding fault also forces the red state - the manual states a ground fault turns the LED indicator red.
causes.ur: Earth fault bhi red state par majboor karta hai - manual ke mutabiq earth fault LED indicator ko red kar deta hai.

solutions.en: Read the active fault code from iSolarCloud or the LCD before doing anything to the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit par kuch karne se pehle iSolarCloud ya LCD se active fault code parh lein.

solutions.en: Then look that code up in the fault table and follow its corrective measures.
solutions.ur: Phir woh code fault table mein dhoondein aur us ke corrective measures follow karein.

solutions.en: Check AC and DC isolation before re-testing, since a red light on this model usually follows a lockout.
solutions.ur: Dobara test karne se pehle AC aur DC isolation check karein, kyun ke is model par red light aam tor par lockout ke baad aati hai.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.en: LED red blinking - Bluetooth plus system fault
title.ur: LED red blink - Bluetooth aur system fault

meaning.en: The red LED blinks: Bluetooth is connected with data communication in progress AND a system fault is present.
meaning.ur: Red LED blink karta hai: Bluetooth juda hai aur data communication chal raha hai AUR system fault bhi maujood hai.

causes.en: A system fault is active while a phone is connected over Bluetooth.
causes.ur: Phone Bluetooth se jude hote hue system fault active hai.

causes.en: A grounding fault is one of the underlying causes while Bluetooth is connected.
causes.ur: Earth fault in underlying causes mein se ek hai jab Bluetooth juda hua ho.

solutions.en: Read the active fault code in the App first - the App will show the code even while Bluetooth is connected.
solutions.ur: Pehle App mein active fault code parh lein - Bluetooth jude hone par bhi App code dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Follow that code's corrective measures; the blinking LED itself adds no extra information.
solutions.ur: Us code ke corrective measures follow karein; khud blink karti LED koi extra maloomati nahi deti.

solutions.en: If no code is shown, power-cycle once with AC and DC isolated for 15 minutes.
solutions.ur: Agar koi code na dikhe to AC aur DC isolate kar ke 15 minute baad ek baar power cycle karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

title.en: LED gray off - both sides powered down
title.ur: LED gray off - dono taraf band

meaning.en: The gray LED is off: both the AC and DC sides are powered down. Voltage may still be present on the AC side after the indicator is off.
meaning.ur: Gray LED off hai: AC aur DC dono taraf band hain. Indicator bujhne ke baad bhi AC side par voltage maujood ho sakta hai.

causes.en: AC breaker and DC switch both open, or the inverter has no power at all.
causes.ur: AC breaker aur DC switch dono khule hain, ya inverter ko bilkul power nahi mil raha.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker and DC switch are set for the intended state.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC breaker aur DC switch sochay huay state mein hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: Treat the AC side as live even with the indicator off, and verify with a meter before touching terminals.
solutions.ur: Indicator off hone par bhi AC side ko live samajhein, aur terminals chhune se pehle meter se tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: If power is expected but the LED is off, verify supplies with a meter then contact Sungrow.
solutions.ur: Agar power mojood hona chahiye magar LED off hai to meter se supply verify kar ke Sungrow se rabta karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)
